propositions: When a ticket description exceeds the configured cap (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000) and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning must be emitted at save time (create or edit) stating length, cap, and that claim requires a passing review.
The save-time warning and the plan-review admission guard must both read the same config key (verify.max_ticket_description_chars) to maintain single-sourcing of the cap threshold.

The warning must be surfaced via three channels: CLI stderr, library logger on the rebar root, and MCP result fields (description_warning on CreateResultOut and WriteAckOut), without blocking or altering the write.
The warning must not appear when the gate is disabled, when the description is within the cap, or when the ticket type is exempt from plan review.
The warning must be computed after the create/edit event is appended and must degrade gracefully to None on any error, ensuring it can never block a write.
